shortcuts.label: Projects view
shortcuts.description: Opens the Projects view with the project thread list.

shortcuts.label: Threads view
shortcuts.description: Opens the Threads view.

shortcuts.label: Projects with scope state
shortcuts.description: Opens the Projects view with the scope sidebar active for the current thread.

shortcuts.label: Scope view
shortcuts.description: Opens the Scope board for the active project.

shortcuts.label: Chats view
shortcuts.description: Opens the Chats view.

shortcuts.label: Settings
shortcuts.description: Opens the Settings page.

shortcuts.label: Command palette
shortcuts.description: Toggles the command palette.

shortcuts.label: New project
shortcuts.description: Starts the new-project flow with local or SSH options.

shortcuts.label: New thread / chat / file
shortcuts.description: Creates a new thread, chat, or scoped thread depending on the current view; creates a file when the file tree is focused.
shortcuts.scenario: Projects, Chats, Threads, or Scope view.

shortcuts.label: Close active surface
shortcuts.description: Closes palettes, the command palette, modals, Settings, an open thread, then finally the window (with a working-threads gate).

shortcuts.label: Delete active thread
shortcuts.description: Opens the delete confirmation for the open thread; Enter on the focused Delete button confirms, Escape cancels.

shortcuts.label: Send message
shortcuts.description: Sends the message, or queues it while the agent is busy. Enter is never a send key — plain Enter always makes a new line or list item.
shortcuts.scenario: Chat composer, message editing, and remote conversation composer.

shortcuts.label: Steer into the running turn
shortcuts.description: Force-sends the message into the live turn mid-turn, skipping the queue.
shortcuts.scenario: Chat composer while the agent is working.

shortcuts.label: Soft line break
shortcuts.description: Inserts a new line without starting a new list item and never sends.

shortcuts.label: Stop agent (double Escape)
shortcuts.description: Presses Escape twice within 800ms to hard-stop the running agent turn; a single Escape cancels a pending stop.
shortcuts.scenario: Composer focused while the agent is working.

shortcuts.label: Dictate with voice
shortcuts.description: Starts voice dictation in whatever input with a microphone is on view — the chat composer, a selection comment, the temporary chat, or an open editor. Defaults to double-pressing the left Alt key (Option on macOS) and can be remapped in Sound > Preferences; Escape stops an active recording.
shortcuts.scenario: Anywhere a microphone input is visible.

shortcuts.label: Recall previous message
shortcuts.description: Steps back through previously sent messages.
shortcuts.scenario: Empty composer or already browsing history.

shortcuts.label: Recall next message
shortcuts.description: Moves forward through history, returning to the saved draft at the end.

shortcuts.label: Toggle engineering mode
shortcuts.description: Toggles the agent engineering (thinking) controls.
shortcuts.scenario: Composer focused with engineering mode available.

shortcuts.label: Navigate mentions
shortcuts.description: Cycles through @ file/task mention candidates.
shortcuts.scenario: While the mention menu is open.

shortcuts.label: Accept mention
shortcuts.description: Inserts the highlighted mention.
shortcuts.scenario: While the mention menu is open.

shortcuts.label: Navigate slash commands
shortcuts.description: Cycles through slash-command candidates.
shortcuts.scenario: While the slash menu is open.

shortcuts.label: Accept slash command
shortcuts.description: Runs the highlighted slash action.
shortcuts.scenario: While the slash menu is open.

shortcuts.label: Submit annotation comment
shortcuts.description: Posts the comment on a response selection; Escape closes the editor.
shortcuts.scenario: Editing a comment on a response selection.

shortcuts.label: Open notification thread
shortcuts.description: Navigates to the thread for the highlighted notification.

shortcuts.label: Undo
shortcuts.description: Undoes the last edit.

shortcuts.label: Redo
shortcuts.description: Redoes the last undone edit. Ctrl+Y also works on Windows/Linux.

shortcuts.label: Bold
shortcuts.description: Wraps the selection in bold.
shortcuts.scenario: Any rich text editor with a selection.

shortcuts.label: Italic
shortcuts.description: Wraps the selection in italics.
shortcuts.scenario: Any rich text editor with a selection.

shortcuts.label: Inline code
shortcuts.description: Wraps the selection as inline code.
shortcuts.scenario: Any rich text editor with a selection.

shortcuts.label: New line in code block
shortcuts.description: Inserts a new line inside a code block; Enter on the language label focuses the code body.

shortcuts.label: Exit code block
shortcuts.description: Creates a paragraph above or below the block when the caret is at its edge.
shortcuts.scenario: Caret at the top or bottom of a code block.

shortcuts.label: Unlist list item
shortcuts.description: Turns the list item back into a paragraph when the caret is at its very start.
shortcuts.scenario: Caret at the start of a list item.

shortcuts.label: Commit staged changes
shortcuts.description: Commits the staged files from the message box. Enter never commits — multi-line messages are safe.
shortcuts.scenario: Git status panel composer or the Commit dialog.

shortcuts.label: Create pull request
shortcuts.description: Creates the pull request from the title or description field.

shortcuts.label: Create branch
shortcuts.description: Creates the new branch; Escape cancels.
shortcuts.scenario: New-branch input in the Git panel.

shortcuts.label: Toggle file diff
shortcuts.description: Opens or closes the diff for the highlighted change.

shortcuts.label: Toggle file selection
shortcuts.description: Toggles the file's staged selection instead of opening its diff.
shortcuts.scenario: File row in the changes tree.

shortcuts.label: Toggle selection checkbox
shortcuts.description: Toggles selection for the focused checkbox (files, directories, or select-all sections).
shortcuts.scenario: Git changes tree / status panel, checkbox focused.

shortcuts.label: Save draft
shortcuts.description: Saves the current spec, assignment, or brainstorm draft.

shortcuts.label: Edit text field
shortcuts.description: Enters inline edit mode on a markdown field; Escape cancels the edit.
shortcuts.scenario: Studio markdown field, not already editing.

shortcuts.label: Navigate spec sections
shortcuts.description: Moves through the spec section list.

shortcuts.label: Resize sidebar
shortcuts.description: Resizes the panel by 16px (48px with Shift).
shortcuts.scenario: Studio sidebar or coordinator panel resize handle focused.

shortcuts.label: New terminal tab
shortcuts.description: Opens a new terminal tab for the active thread.

shortcuts.label: Word backward / forward
shortcuts.description: Moves the cursor by whole words in plain shells.
shortcuts.scenario: Terminal focused in a shell prompt (not on the alternate screen).

shortcuts.label: Reveal file in explorer
shortcuts.description: Reveals the clicked file path in the OS file manager.
shortcuts.scenario: Clicking a path link in the terminal.

shortcuts.label: Save file
shortcuts.description: Saves the active file tab.
shortcuts.scenario: A file tab is open and has unsaved changes.

shortcuts.label: Go to line
shortcuts.description: Opens the go-to-line bar; Enter jumps to the line, Escape closes.

shortcuts.label: Insert indentation
shortcuts.description: Inserts two spaces instead of moving focus.

shortcuts.label: Find next match
shortcuts.description: Moves to the next match in the find bar.

shortcuts.label: Find previous match
shortcuts.description: Moves to the previous match in the find bar.

shortcuts.label: Navigate file tree
shortcuts.description: Moves selection; ArrowRight expands or descends, ArrowLeft collapses or ascends. Shift+Arrow extends the range.

shortcuts.label: Commit rename / create
shortcuts.description: Confirms an inline create or rename; Escape cancels.

shortcuts.label: Search deployment logs
shortcuts.description: Opens log search; Escape closes it.

shortcuts.label: Navigate model list
shortcuts.description: Moves between model rows.

shortcuts.label: Select model
shortcuts.description: Activates the highlighted model.

shortcuts.label: Toggle model favorite
shortcuts.description: Favorites or unfavorites the highlighted model.
shortcuts.scenario: Favorite star focused in the model picker.

shortcuts.label: Close overlay
shortcuts.description: Closes the command palette, model picker, appearance picker, and similar overlays.
shortcuts.scenario: A palette, menu, or picker is open.

shortcuts.label: Open thread switcher
shortcuts.description: Opens the thread switcher; Ctrl+Shift+Tab cycles backward. Releasing Ctrl selects the highlighted thread, Escape cancels.
shortcuts.scenario: A project with at least one thread.

shortcuts.label: Toggle thread pin
shortcuts.description: Pins or unpins the thread.

shortcuts.label: Find in conversation
shortcuts.description: Opens the in-conversation find bar.

shortcuts.label: Commit device rename
shortcuts.description: Commits the device name edit; Escape cancels.

shortcuts.label: Activate focused control
shortcuts.description: Activates the focused button, menu item, or row (native behavior).

shortcuts.label: Close modal / sheet
shortcuts.description: Closes the top modal, side sheet, or dockable panel.

shortcuts.label: Close media preview
shortcuts.description: Closes the attachment or media preview.
